title: Desk Reference — Billing-Error Credits on Per-Worker Fee Lines of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement
content:
**Subject.** Under the employer-paid fee model of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement the per-worker fee line bills the per-worker fee these provisions settle. A line billed in error is credited in full with reason billing error, except the most recently billed per-worker fee line, on which the billing-error credit is the amount billed above the per-worker fee as these provisions settle it. The billing-error credit owed on that line is booked by the desk as a credit memo pointing to it.

## Booking the credit

The desk books the credit with the tool `credit_worker_fee_overbilling_e0c50836`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. It books a billing-error credit memo against one per-worker fee line of a monthly program invoice, for the part of that line the employer was billed in excess, and is performed by the desk on behalf of a verified employer contact. One call creates one credit memo with the reason given, pointing to the per-worker fee line named and carrying the billing month given, and lowers the program charges the employer currently owes on the agreement by the credited amount. The employer sees the credit on its program statement against that invoice line.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement, read from the agreement record returned by the program agreement finder |
| `related_entry_id` | the billing entry reference number of the per-worker fee invoice line being credited, read from the invoice line returned by the program billing finder |
| `billing_month` | the calendar month the credited line bills, written as four-digit year, hyphen, two-digit month (YYYY-MM), copied from that invoice line; never empty |
| `credit_reason` | why the credit memo is booked, exactly one of the values listed below |
| `credit_amount` | the amount credited, in US dollars, a number with 2 decimal places; any further decimals are rounded half up to the cent by the tool |

Values of `credit_reason`: `billing_error` — the per-worker fee line was billed above the fee owed for that month and the excess is credited; `sla_credit` — the month's measured platform availability fell below the commitment; `go_live_delay_credit` — go-live came later than the committed target for reasons on Paystride's side; `late_charge_waiver` — a late charge is waived as a courtesy; `none` — the credit is booked without a stated reason.

## Return

A single text line: "Credited <amount> USD on line <related_entry_id> (<billing_month>) as credit memo <credit memo reference>; program charges owed now <amount> USD." The amounts are US dollars with two decimals, the credit memo reference is the new billing entry reference number, and the last figure is the agreement's program charges still owed with the credit applied. A receipt line beginning with "Credited" means the credit memo is booked.
